About me

Code is my craft,
products are the goal.

I'm Sĩ Thiện, a software engineer based in Da Nang, Vietnam with 3 years of experience across company and freelance work. At SupremeTech I build a white-label OTT streaming platform and e-commerce products used across multiple brands; as a freelancer I ship beauty and podcast platforms for international clients.

I graduated from the Vietnam–Korea University of Information and Communication Technology (VKU) with a GPA of 3.3/4, and I work in English at B1 level. Alongside client work, I run my own e-commerce store — which taught me to think like a product owner: every millisecond and every pixel has to earn its place.

  • ✓ Performance-first: Core Web Vitals in the green, always
  • ✓ End-to-end ownership — design handoff to deployment
  • ✓ Clear communication, daily updates, no surprises

01Real-time WebGL

Two independent Three.js scenes on one page, each paused automatically when off-screen or when the tab is hidden — interactivity without burning battery.

03Production mindset

Capped pixel ratio, pooled geometries and no layout thrash — the techniques that keep client sites at 60fps, demonstrated here instead of just claimed.
